synopsis: NR-12 is Brazil’s machinery safety regulation; together with NR-22, it covers general mining and machinery occupational safety [f2287, f2797, f15579]. The two regulations set general machine, mining, brake and operating requirements, a scope repeated in the glossary [f2288, f2798, f15579]. Chapter 3 reports that no automatic-braking mandate was found, specifically no ISO 21815-style mandate prescribing target or speed tests in the reviewed Brazilian text [f2799, f2289]. The corpus therefore identifies general safety and braking requirements, but does not establish a prescribed automatic-braking test regime under these regulations [f2288, f2289].
